main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). A spacious, completely flat country circuit located in northern New South Wales. Features a long 400m home straight. Despite the generous straight, regional country race tempos favor forward-placed pressers ('P') and rolling leaders ('E') on top of the ground.
main_turf.post_bias: Fair across middle distances (1300m, 1400m, 1600m) due to the long home straight. In 950m and 1200m sprints, inside barriers (stalls 1–4) help navigate the early positioning into the top bend.

handicapping_angles.tamworth_and_se_qld_border_shippers: Moree sits near the QLD border and regularly attracts high-volume yards from Tamworth, Inverell, Goondiwindi, and Toowoomba (e.g. Cody Morgan, Peter Sinclair, Mark Currie). Upgrade shippers coming off Tamworth or Toowoomba provincial maidens and BM58s (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.flat_oval_rolling_tempo_advantage: On firm to soft ground, rolling leaders ('E') and prominent pressers ('P') that control the middle stages are difficult to run down. Avoid deep back-markers unless early pace is contested.
handicapping_angles.moree_cup_showcase_class: During the Moree Cup Showcase meeting in September, race quality elevates to Provincial level. Factor in higher par offsets for Cup day feature races.
